rule: valid_mask = NOT (mean-over-layers-and-heads column profile, taken over post-image text query rows, > median + k*MAD). Whole-arm constant rule; per-image threshold; no field value is rescaled and no cell is interpolated.

ceiling_cost.note: the price of the valid mask: an excluded cell cannot be selected by the matched-area top-k, so GT mass sitting on a sink is unreachable for every field including the oracle
